title: Measured deterministic sparse assignment search below unit clause weight
claims: MeasuredLowWeightSearch constructs a sparse satisfying assignment for every canonical CNF of dyadic clause weight below one whose clauses use distinct variables.
MeasuredClauseWeight checks the weight threshold using a bounded unary carry, with a width histogram rather than explicit exponential denominators.
MeasuredVariableRestriction gives measured assignment restriction and variable erasure on canonical CNFs.

ExactLowWeightSAT checks P membership for the exact low-weight language with distinct variables in each clause. All its well-formed guarded formulas are satisfiable by the measured witness construction.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
